abilities.effect: The slab rips free from its track and falls, slamming down in one direction while it kicks up twisted metal debris in the other. All creatures adjacent to the slab take 3d6 bludgeoning and 3d6 piercing damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save).
abilities.name: Falling Slab
abilities.trigger: A creature attempts to move the slab

hazard.description: The stone slab tears free from its track with the ear-piercing sound of failing metal.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Crafting (expert) to shore up the track so that it functions as intended, or DC 18 Thievery (trained) to wedge the slab in place to immobilize it.
hazard.name: Loose Slab

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
